scope: Learning-budget diagnosis, not a new architecture: keep the V6 physical actor-memory interface and the strongest contextual/same-placement/zero-history controls. Increase only the shared online MC episode budget from 1000 to 3000. The same successful demonstrations, IL epochs, rewards, action support, observation contract and final-checkpoint evaluation remain fixed. No claim of convergence or model novelty follows from a budget increase.
sensor: 360-degree centre-ray human-body occlusion; no range cutoff or random dropout
association: Ideal association of previously visible actors; identity is not a numeric model input
primary: Success rate in unseen 10/20-person populations, equally weighted; 5-person SR is a robustness check
checkpoint_selection: Final fixed-budget checkpoint only; no outcome-selected stopping or checkpoints
allowed_revision: This run changes only online training duration. It does not increase IL data or introduce another memory gate, predictor, loss, reward, horizon or query interface. The zero-history control keeps the exact V6 elapsed-clock configuration and legal age/gap inputs, not an information-free Sensor arm. IL snapshots may be reused only when seed and complete configuration match; their source/hash and all original IL logs must be preserved. Each candidate and control receives 3000 MC episodes, including the complete epsilon decay. No fresh seeds/cases until a development winner is eligible. A negative budget test is a version-level diagnosis, not a temporal/KDA-family rejection.
